niche: a city-region rail executive siting the one platform dispatch team its 2027 rail plan funds on its suburban network, valued at the passenger lateness the team would take off the network's weekday trains
answer: Site the 2027 platform dispatch team at Pellingham: it takes 4,100 passenger-minutes of lateness a weekday off the network's trains, 1,200 more than Saltgate's 2,900.
analyst_test: A strong analyst who reads every file correctly prices each station's team at the dwell overrun it would remove there, carried down the same train to each passenger's alighting stop net of the timetable's recovery allowances, and files the station whose trains carry the most passengers through the largest overruns; that route never follows a late unit into its next working and names the wrong station.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is each siting's passenger lateness avoided across the network, which rail performance analysis builds from train running records, the working timetable's recovery allowances and turnaround slack and the units each working uses; with hospital nouns (discharge teams on wards) there is no timetable whose allowances absorb lateness, no passenger loading along a route and no unit carrying a late arrival into a full working, so the call stops making sense.
layer1: the running feed stamps calls on the half-minute against TIPLOC timing points while the census, the claims and the gates key stations by CRS code and name
the working timetable exports booked times to the second with bracketed allowances
a failed unit's workings pass to a spare on the day, so the record's unit changes mid-day
the passenger census counts each train's boarders and alighters on one autumn weekday
the gateline controllers log cumulative 16-bit counters every quarter-hour in UTC
the claims extract carries appeal top-ups under the original claim reference and app-entered journey dates
stakeholder_role: the rail executive's performance analyst, whose siting note goes with the 2027 rail plan

spine.entity: one row is one weekday train's call at one timing point, with the unit that worked it
spine.grain: date x headcode x timing point

driver: The decisive quantity is what removing part of the delay a vehicle picks up at one point saves across a whole system, when the vehicle passes on to its next assignment whatever part of its lateness exceeds the slack before that assignment, so equal local delays cost the system very differently according to how tightly each vehicle's next assignment follows and how full it is, which only the vehicles' own sequences of assignments show.
driver_concrete: Each shortlisted station's team is worth the passenger lateness it takes off the network's weekday trains; Pellingham's overruns fall on Ambrey line all-stations trains whose units reach Ravelstoke Central with half a minute to spare over the four minutes a unit needs to turn round and go straight out on the full outbound airport workings, while Ambrey Parkway's fall mostly on park-and-ride extras whose units do not work again until the evening, so Pellingham's minutes reach far more passengers than its own trains carry.
stump: The default path prices each shortlisted station's team at the overrun it removes there, carried down the same train to each passenger's alighting station net of the timetable's allowances, and files Saltgate at about 2,900 passenger-minutes a weekday; the step that lands it there is stopping each train's lateness at Ravelstoke Central, when the Ambrey line's all-stations units turn round there with half a minute of slack and start their full outbound airport workings late, so Pellingham's team, 4,100, is the call.

differentiation.task184: task184 v1 differenced a site's own filed plan against its record; nothing here is a plan differenced against a record: the saving is followed from each delayed train into its unit's next workings across the turnround slack.
differentiation.task198: task198 reads a reported value capped at what an agreement entitles; here nothing is capped and the deciding quantity is lateness a vehicle carries from one working into the next, weighted by that working's passengers.
differentiation.task472: task472's job is released only inside a schedule's windows, so shortening its own work saves only where it crosses a window; here the saving lands on other trains, the unit's next workings, which start late by the lateness beyond the layover slack and carry their own passengers.
differentiation.task118: v2 asked what share of a measured gain is new to the whole system rather than taken from the items beside it, and v4 valued a levy cut on the welfare wedge; v6 adds what the local record never shows, the lateness a delayed train's unit carries into its next working, with no displacement, price or welfare step.
differentiation.task119: task119 credits a trust's failed waits to beds its unit held empty for its own planned work, read from each allocation against its occupant's record; here nothing is held or allocated: the saving is the lateness a delayed train's unit carries across a turnround into its next working, weighted by that working's passengers.

lineage.architecture: v1 (loops 0 to 4, shipped 10-12, reshipped 10-27 after the portal's determinism block): the headlines each desk's own editors already test netted out of the squad's sized gain
lineage.fate: FAILED_TO_STUMP 2026-10-27: both portal responses filed Culture·national at 1,250,000 (the golden), by keeping the clicks from Bightline's own surfaces and dropping the articles a desk had already tested, a filter they read as obvious (a tested headline cannot be tested again); shrinkage against the change log moved only the figure, never the desk
lineage.driver: The gain a specialist team adds to a unit is its effect on the reachable volume the unit does not already treat itself, because the unit's own past trials, which supply the measured effect, have already banked their gains in the volume carried forward; every closed deployment went to units that had never run a trial of their own, so the shrunk effect times reachable volume reproduces all of them, while the unit leading on that basis already treats the items that carry most of its reachable volume and a unit that has treated little of its own overtakes it.
lineage.stump: A competent solver rebuilds each desk's winning lift from the test archive, shrinks it as the seven closed embeddings' realised holdback lifts require, counts only the clicks that start on surfaces that show the tested headline, and names Local·metro at 2,800,000; the step that lands them there is never asking who ran the tests behind each desk's lift, which the archive's test owners joined to the newsroom staff list answer: Local·metro's own editors already test the headlines behind 71.1% of its platform clicks, so most of the gain the squad was sized on is already in the plan.

lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-27 at the portal (FAILED_TO_STUMP after the determinism reship): both responses landed the call once the brief's sign-off required each closed embedding reproduced
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is the share of an item's measured gain that is new to the whole system rather than taken from the items shown beside it, which is one minus the rate at which a view of the shared display already ends in a choice; a unit whose volume arrives through displays that nearly always convert keeps little of its measured gain, so the unit leading on the measured gain falls behind one whose volume arrives through displays that rarely convert.

lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-27 at the portal (FAILED_TO_STUMP): both responses filed the golden (Saltreach Coast, 19 emergency fall admissions avoided, runner-up Hethermoss 4 fewer) by dating each user's start through the repeat-template chains, the policy's 'months since the patient first started' sending every reader to the start
lineage.driver: A harm that eases with time since a unit's exposure began is priced from the first record of it in an activity log that opened after most exposures began, so every long-exposed unit looks newly exposed; each unit's real start lives in another record whose chain of renewals reaches back, and the candidate with the most units, mostly long exposed, loses to the one whose units began recently.

A fixed revenue envelope given to one of several levies is valued by the welfare loss it removes, which is every extra unit's full existing wedge less half the cut, on the quantity the market actually reaches within the appraisal year; a response read off the long-run or static elasticity credits the slowest-adjusting levy with demand it will not reach in the year, and the cut's own triangle alone credits the most elastic small levy, so each half of the method names a different levy and only both together name the right one.
lineage.stump: A competent analyst estimates each duty's price elasticity by a log-log fit of the Statistics Office's quarterly clearances on shelf prices, sizes each cut to the GBP 1.5 million envelope after buyers respond and values it as the cut's own Harberger triangle, filing cider at about GBP 0.2 million where the golden is spirits at about GBP 0.9 million; the step that lands them there is valuing a cut by its own triangle on a static elasticity, when every extra litre a cut buys still carries the whole of the duty and GST on it and the Budget year sees only the part of each duty's response that has arrived by then.
lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-31 at the portal: the call landed three times and the determinism block failed twice; the golden was the field's own welfare method (the existing wedge plus the cut's triangle on the year's partial-adjustment quantity), which the portal's responses applied by reflex, so the slot re-roots into a new world, dataset, decisive step and prompt shell

lineage.fate: FAILED_TO_STUMP 2026-11-07 on its first portal round: both responses filed the golden (Home Battery Network 6 MW, runner-up Peak Time Rewards 4 MW, every programme's MW) by putting a consecutive-call streak in the event regression, splitting the batteries' contract regimes and validating season-out; a named covariate the field already models is executed, so the world and the run-position driver are spent
lineage.driver: A resource's response is measured on occasions that mostly stand alone, while the occasion the decision prices comes at the end of a run of consecutive calls that the operating rule makes out of the design conditions, and a response drawn from a buffer that refills only partly between calls falls with each consecutive call, so every average or condition-matched measure overstates exactly the resources whose buffer empties and the resource that refills between calls wins.
lineage.stump: The default path averages each program's 18:00 treatment-against-holdout reduction over the 2024 to 2026 events, or fits it on the day's high and reads the fit at the design hour's 117F, multiplies by the units the USD 3.2 million buys and files Cool Credit at about 10 to 11 MW; it never places the design peak hour in its run of dispatch days, so it misses that the three weekdays before it clear OP-7's trigger and that on the record's fourth consecutive event days the thermostats give about a fifth of a first day's reduction.
